name: GM - Fairfax Assembly, Kansas City KS

fieldNotes.facility: GM Fairfax Assembly & Stamping, Kansas City KS (3201 Fairfax Trafficway). Confirmed via web research (4.9M sq ft, building Cadillac XT4 / Chevy Malibu, retooling for the 2027 Bolt EV/Equinox) and satellite: a massive integrated automotive campus in the Fairfax Industrial District beside the Missouri River, with a multi-million-sq-ft assembly/body/paint complex, thousands of finished vehicles in staging lots, and rail auto-rack loading tracks. The supplied address point landed ~2km SW in a residential neighborhood; the true campus is NE in the industrial district, re-pinned to the main assembly building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Campus is fully perimeter-fenced (chain-link with GM/XPO banners visible in Street View). Truck traffic enters via controlled drives; the XPO Logistics inbound-parts building on the south side has a fenced, gated truck entrance off the public road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Automotive assembly plants of this scale operate staffed security gatehouses at controlled entries; booth structures consistent with guarded entry are present, though the exact booth was not isolated in a single frame, so flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. The XPO sequencing/cross-dock building (a long diagonal structure on the south end) has continuous dock banks down BOTH long faces with dozens of trailers backed in; combined with parts-receiving docks on the assembly building, total easily exceeds 100 doors. Count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band. Extensive trailer drop/staging around the XPO building and the assembly building's receiving aprons; well over 50 dropped trailers visible.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer storage/staging lots adjacent to the XPO logistics building and on the assembly building's receiving side.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple active rail spurs and long parallel auto-rack loading tracks run into the SE of the property; finished-vehicle rail loading clearly visible.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Integrated campus: separate assembly/body building, paint, the XPO inbound-logistics/sequencing building, stamping/older industrial buildings on the west, plus finished-vehicle and rail yards.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts receiving (XPO logistics building, south) is physically separate from finished-vehicle outbound (rail/truck loading from the staging lots, east).
fieldNotes.multiStep: Plant-scale security implies an outer fenced perimeter checkpoint plus internal building access control before docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane drives and large gate aprons at the XPO entrance leave room for a dedicated express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified in imagery; left uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban — inside the Kansas City metro's dense Fairfax Industrial District.

citations.claim: GM newsroom: GM directs major investment in Fairfax (Kansas City KS) workforce to launch new vehicles (Chevrolet Bolt, Equinox)
GM $390M retooling of Fairfax Assembly, Kansas City KS; Bolt EV assembly begins Nov 2025, gas Equinox mid-2027; Barra quoted

verification.rationale: GM-operated Fairfax Assembly & Stamping, actively retooling and launching new vehicles. NOTE: the old 'Fairfax 1' plant is a separate Motors-Liquidation brownfield/environmental site; the operating site here is Fairfax Assembly & Stamping (Fairfax 2), retained and run by GM today.
